name: MOB-001 - Mobile App Project Setup & WebRTC Native SDK Integration
Description:
Initialize React Native / Expo mobile project for iOS and Android. Expectation: App builds cleanly on iOS Simulator and Android Emulator with WebRTC native library linked.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Cross-platform Expo SDK 56 project initialized with TypeScript
- `react-native-webrtc` and `mediasoup-client` successfully linked
- Base app navigation structure configured using `@react-navigation/native`
- Setup Playwright (`@playwright/test`) for E2E testing framework

name: MOB-002 - Secure Token Storage & Biometric Auth Setup
Description:
Implement secure token storage using `expo-secure-store` and `@react-native-async-storage/async-storage` with biometric login via `expo-local-authentication`. Expectation: Secure token persistence.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Encrypted storage for refresh tokens and session keys
- Biometric authentication prompt (Face ID / Fingerprint) for returning users
- Automatic token refresh logic executing before token expiry
- Logout action securely wipes all local credentials

name: MOB-003 - Deep Linking Handler (WhatsApp  SMS  QR Codes)
Description:
Implement universal deep link handlers for `konn3ct://join/{roomId}` and `https://konn3ct.com/join/{roomId}`. Expectation: Tapping link in WhatsApp opens app directly to pre-meeting lobby.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Configured Android Intent Filters and iOS Universal Links via Expo config
- Extracts `roomId`, `passcode`, and `referralCode` query parameters from deep link URL
- Routes user directly to Pre-Meeting Lobby screen if app is installed
- Fallback redirect to App Store / Play Store if app is not installed

name: MOB-004 - Push Notifications Integration (FCM & APNs)
Description:
Configure push notifications using `expo-notifications` for Android (FCM) and iOS (APNs). Expectation: Displays interactive push notification banners.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Handles background, foreground, and killed state push notifications
- Displays notification banners for 'Meeting Starting', 'Host Admitted You', 'Replay Ready'
- One-tap 'Join Now' action button on notification directly launches target meeting room
- Registers mobile device token to Kay's backend API

name: MOB-005 - Mobile Hardware Permissions & Camera/Mic Selector
Description:
Build native permission request screens for Camera and Microphone with front/rear camera selection. Expectation: Graceful handling of denied permissions.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Prompts native iOS/Android camera and mic permission requests using Expo permissions APIs
- Provides clear explanation dialog if user previously denied permission with button to open OS Settings
- Camera toggle button switching between Front and Rear facing cameras
- Remembers preferred camera choice using Zustand global state

name: MOB-006 - Bluetooth Headset & Audio Output Router
Description:
Implement dynamic audio routing component using `react-native-incall-manager` handling automatic switching between Speakerphone, Earpiece, and Bluetooth headsets. Expectation: Seamless audio transition.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Listens to Bluetooth headset connection/disconnection events (SCO/A2DP)
- Audio output selector modal allowing manual choice: 'Speaker', 'Earpiece', 'Bluetooth'
- Automatically routes audio to Bluetooth headset when connected mid-call
- Handles incoming phone call interruptions gracefully (pausing WebRTC audio)

name: MOB-007 - Mobile Pre-Meeting Self-View & Audio Level Meter
Description:
Build mobile pre-meeting preview screen showing camera self-view and mic volume level bar styled with NativeWind/TailwindCSS. Expectation: Mobile users can verify audio/video before entering room.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Renders 16:9 self-view preview video container using NativeWind styling
- Audio volume level bar reflecting live microphone input
- Mute Mic and Video Off toggle buttons in preview
- 'Join Session' button triggering Kay's `validate-join` API

name: MOB-008 - Mobile Waiting Room Screen & Admission Listener
Description:
Build mobile waiting room UI displayed when host has enabled waiting room. Expectation: Displays animated waiting screen until host admits mobile user.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Clean branded mobile screen showing Meeting Title and Host Name
- Listens to WebSocket event from host (`ADMIT_USER`) via `socket.io-client` to auto-transition into meeting room
- 'Leave Queue' button returning user to app home screen
- Displays notification if host rejects entry

name: MOB-009 - Mobile Live Meeting Grid & Active Speaker Canvas
Description:
Build mobile meeting room canvas optimized for portrait and landscape screen orientations using NativeWind. Expectation: Smooth WebRTC stream rendering.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Portrait Mode: Active Speaker video on top half, 2x2 scrollable grid on bottom half
- Landscape Mode: Full screen video with auto-hiding controls
- Active speaker tile highlighted with green border
- Automatic orientation sensor listener updating layout seamlessly

name: MOB-010 - Mobile Bottom Control Bar & Gesture Controls
Description:
Build mobile control bar with gesture shortcuts. Expectation: Compact control bar for mobile.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Buttons: Mic Mute, Video Toggle, Raise Hand, Chat Badge, More Options, Leave
- Auto-hides control bar after 5 seconds of inactivity in full screen
- Tap screen anywhere to reveal controls
- 'Leave Room' modal prompting for confirmation

name: MOB-011 - Mobile In-Meeting Chat Drawer Component
Description:
Build mobile chat slide-up drawer for live text messaging. Expectation: Non-intrusive chat drawer on mobile screens.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Slide-up bottom sheet for chat without disconnecting video stream
- Switch between 'Public Chat' and 'Host Private Chat'
- Keyboard avoiding view ensuring input field remains visible when typing
- Unread message badge on bottom bar chat icon

name: MOB-012 - Mobile Participant List & Raise Hand Queue
Description:
Build mobile participant list modal showing connected users, audio/video status, and raise-hand queue. Expectation: Clean mobile participant management.

Acceptance Criteria:
- List of connected participants sorted with Raised Hands at the top managed by Zustand state
- Host controls if logged in as host: 'Mute Participant', 'Lower Hand', 'Remove'
- Search bar filtering participants by name
- Real-time updates as participants join/leave

name: MOB-013 - Mobile Low-Bandwidth Mode & Data Saver Toggle
Description:
Build mobile data saver mode automatically muting incoming video tracks when on weak 3G/4G connections. Expectation: Reduces mobile data usage significantly.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Data Saver toggle in mobile room settings
- When enabled, stops rendering incoming participant video and switches to Audio-Only mode with avatar badges
- Displays toast: 'Data Saver Active - Incoming Video Muted'
- Reduces battery consumption and network packet drop rate

name: MOB-014 - Mobile Screen Share Viewer Canvas
Description:
Build mobile viewer screen for presenter screen sharing. Expectation: Pinch-to-zoom support for shared presentation slides.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Renders presenter screen share stream in high resolution
- Pinch-to-zoom and pan gesture support on mobile display stage
- Picture-in-Picture (PiP) mode support via `react-native-pip-android` when app goes to background
- Floating active speaker thumbnail in corner

name: MOB-015 - Mobile TrustLock Watermark & Security Badges
Description:
Build mobile rendering for TrustLock dynamic video watermarks and verified identity badges (Volume 10). Expectation: Renders participant email watermark overlay on mobile video.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Renders semi-transparent floating text watermark (email + IP) across mobile video canvas
- Verified checkmark badge on mobile participant tiles for enterprise users
- Pulsing red 'REC' badge on top status bar during active recordings
- Prevents Android OS screenshot capture via `FLAG_SECURE` when room security policy mandates

name: MOB-016 - Mobile Replay Player & AI Chapter Index
Description:
Build native mobile video player for recorded sessions with interactive AI summary chapters. Expectation: Smooth mobile replay playback.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Mobile video controls: Play/Pause, 10s Skip, Playback Speed, Fullscreen
- Interactive AI summary list below player with clickable timestamp jump links
- Tapping timestamp jumps video head to specified position
- Supports portrait and landscape video playback

name: MOB-017 - Mobile Synchronized Transcript Viewer
Description:
Build mobile transcript slide-up sheet displaying synchronized meeting text. Expectation: Auto-scrolls with video playback.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Search input to filter transcript keywords
- Auto-scrolls to active sentence as video plays
- Tapping any transcript sentence jumps video playback to that exact timestamp
- Copy transcript text action button

name: MOB-018 - Mobile PayGate Checkout & Ticket Purchase Flow
Description:
Build mobile ticket purchase flow using `react-native-webview` for paid webinars and paid replays (Volume 8). Expectation: Seamless in-app payment experience.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Renders event pricing summary and payment gateway selection
- In-App Browser / Webview container executing secure Paystack/Stripe checkout
- Listens to payment completion callback to instantly unlock video stream access
- Displays digital ticket receipt with QR code

name: MOB-019 - Mobile Network Telemetry & Offline Recovery
Description:
Implement mobile network state listener capturing RTT latency and packet loss logs. Expectation: Auto-reconnects when moving between WiFi and Cellular data.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Listens to network interface changes (WiFi to 4G/5G handoff)
- Automatically triggers WebRTC transport reconnection without dropping meeting session
- Sends background telemetry batch to Kay's API (`API-049`) via Axios
- Displays banner when device loses internet connection

name: MOB-020 - App Store & Play Store Build Package Prep
Description:
Configure EAS (Expo Application Services) build profiles and bundle signing for Google Play and Apple App Store. Expectation: Production-ready APK/AAB and IPA release builds.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Android AAB bundle compiled via EAS Build
- iOS IPA release build signed with Production Distribution Certificate
- App icons and splash screens configured via Expo config
- App Store privacy labels and permissions strings configured
